note: Known high/critical advisories in production dependencies at the moment the audit
gate landed (issue #99), each named with the ticket that owns the fix. The gate
(scripts/check-audit.mjs) fails on any high/critical advisory NOT listed here, so
this file is the line between 'debt we have already booked' and 'something new'.
Adding an entry is an explicit, reviewable decision — give the id, the package, and
the ticket or reason. Removing entries is the point: the weekly audit workflow fails
when a listed advisory is no longer reported, so a fix prunes its own line.
Baseline captured 2026-08-06: 64 advisories total, 1 critical + 24 high.
